title: murmur-notes-candidate-gabriel-mcintyre
content:
Candidate: Gabriel McIntyre (applied for Senior Runtime Engineer)
Interviewer loop: phone-screen -> take-home -> on-site loop (system design + debugging + pairing)
Quick gut: smart, pragmatic, subtle infra instincts. Comfortable with tradeoffs between latency and cost. Strong sense for operational edge cases (cache invalidation, KV eviction patterns).

Phone screen notes (30m):
- Background: multiple infra roles at small infra-focused startup, recent work on optimizing transformer KV caches in TF/XLA pipelines.
- Communication: clear, slightly terse, good at analogies (compares cache hit curves to conveyor-belt warehouses).
- Flags: said they "hand-rolled" a lot of infra without clear testing story. Need to probe for observability + debugging habits.

Take-home (48h):
- Implementation: submitted optimized batched inference stub. Code readable, good docstrings, used microbenchmarks.
- Missed: no test harness, minimal fuzzing, no perf regression guardrails. Suggest ask: would they wire CI perf tests?

On-site loop notes (3 interviews):
1) System design (Clara): designed a fallback routing strategy for mixed-precision model variants. Pros: practical, cost-aware; Cons: light on SLO verification and capacity planning math.
2) Debugging deep-dive (Samir): walked through an incident post-mortem. Candidate emphasized postmortem culture and limited blamelessness examples — gave concrete mitigation steps.
3) Pairing (me): worked through a live KV cache bug. Candidate found root cause quickly (off-by-one in TTL cascade) and proposed a staged rollout + canary metric. Implementation detail level: solid.

Scorecard (1-5):
- System design: 4
- Debugging & ops: 4
- Code quality: 4
- Communication: 3.5
- Culture/Collaboration: 3.5

Green flags:
- Thoughtful about operational tradeoffs and cost controls
- Practical proposals for graceful degradation and fallbacks
- Shipping mentality: quick experiments + measuring outcomes

Red flags / Risks:
- Limited evidence of long-term automated testing/perf CI in prior roles
- Tendency to accept quick rollouts; needs guardrails to avoid technical debt accumulation
- Unknowns on large-scale capacity planning (across regions/pools) — mostly single-cluster experience

Suggested follow-ups before hire:
- Ask for concrete examples of perf regression CI or how they'd instrument a canary for a model variant swap (metrics, thresholds, alerting).
- Ask about mentoring/leadership: times they pushed back on product to improve SLO or observability
- Small homework: sketch a rollout + CI plan for introducing KV cache invalidation threshold tuning across Dedicated clusters.

Offer/level recommendation: Senior eng (IC4) with development plan focused on SLO tooling and perf-test ownership. If candidate shows stronger leadership on follow-ups, consider IC4+.

Ramp plan (first 90 days):
- 0-30: pair with SREs on existing canaries and runbook ownership; add perf tests for one model route
- 30-60: lead a small experiment (quantization + batching config) with measurable unit-cost delta; present results
- 60-90: own rollout of KV cache tuning and automated regression alerts

Notes to self (private):
- Follow-up ask due by next Tue: perf CI artifacts + one code sample with test harness
- If offer, include clause: 3-month review with measurable perf deliverable
- Watch for signs of over-optimizing for single-cluster, push discussion toward multi-region failure modes

Unresolved/questions:
- Exactly which observability stacks did they own? (Prometheus? Internal tracing?)
- Can they design capacity math for bursty workloads (seq len variance)?

Tone: mostly positive, caution around long-term SRE practices. Candidate would be a strong hands-on implementer for runtime work; needs structured onboarding on perf automation.

Quick action items:
- Ask Clara to add a short note about SLO verification math from the design interview
- Email candidate with homework prompt by EOD Friday
- Decide by EOW whether to extend an offer (pending follow-up artifacts)

-- end of scratchpad --
